_about: Public-domain James Harris Fairchild (1817-1902), Oberlin theologian and its third president, for the Word Hoard: Oberlin, its Origin, Progress and Results (1860), Coeducation of the Sexes (1867), Present Demand of the Missionary Work (1877), Oberlin: the Colony and the College (1883), Moral Science (1892 printing) and Elements of Theology, Natural and Revealed (1892), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 57 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

fairchild-oberlin-1860: Oberlin, its origin, progress and results: an address, prepared for the alumni of Oberlin College, assembled August 22, 1860 (Oberlin : Shankland and Harmon, 1860)
fairchild-coeducation: Coeducation of the sexes : an address before a meeting of college presidents at Springfield, Ill ([S.l. : s.n.], 1867)
fairchild-missionary-work: Present demand of the missionary work : a sermon preached at the sixty-eighth annual meeting of the American Board of Commissioners for Foreign Missions, Providence, Oct. 2, 1877 (Beacon Press, 1877)
fairchild-oberlin-colony: Oberlin: the colony and the college, 1833-1883 (Oberlin E.J. Goodrich, 1883)
fairchild-moral-science: Moral science; or, The philosophy of obligation (New York, Sheldon & company, 1892)
fairchild-elements-theology: Elements of theology, natural and revealed (Oberlin, Ohio : E. J. Goodrich, 1892)

_excluded.fairchild-other: Finney's Systematic Theology (1878), which he edited (Finney's book, held on the charles-finney shelf); Reminiscences of Finney (several speakers); Woman's Right to the Ballot (political); books by Charles S. Fairchild and others
